decisions.decision: Dates in the Directives are to be changed to the revision date of June 24, 2009, received in Planning Office June 25, 2009.
The sentence in Finding 6 about a Notice of Project Change is to be deleted, since the NPC is not needed.
Cross easement, operating agreement and maintenance agreement are a prerequisite to occupancy.
